issues.title: Thread context_files through create, amend, decompose, ops, and materialization
issues.dod: context_files can be set at create time, replaced or cleared through amend, preserved by decompose-apply, stored in append-only ops, materialized onto issues, and used by validation without requiring scope weakening.
issues.scope: cmd/armature/create.go, cmd/armature/amend.go, cmd/armature/decompose.go, internal/decompose/plan.go, internal/decompose/apply.go, internal/ops/types.go, internal/materialize/engine.go, internal/materialize/state.go, internal/validate/validate.go

acceptance.description: create/amend/decompose to materialization to validate flow preserves context_files

issues.title: Render curated context_files in working memory
issues.dod: render-context includes curated context_files as stable reference material without treating them as write scope, and tests cover deleted or missing files without hiding validation warnings.

acceptance.description: rendered working memory distinguishes context_files from scope and context snippets

issues.title: Move op-log authentication into materialization input
Introduce a validated op-stream interface for materialization callers
issues.dod: Commands and TUI load append-only ops through one validated op-stream interface that preserves log filename context, returns offsets, excludes filename-worker-ID mismatches, and exposes warnings to callers.

acceptance.description: mismatched worker IDs in log files are excluded from command and TUI materialization paths

issues.title: Add integration coverage for invalid op exclusion
issues.dod: arm materialize, arm validate, arm ready, and TUI-adjacent loading tests prove invalid cross-worker ops are excluded and warnings remain visible.

acceptance.description: invalid ops cannot affect ready, validate, or materialized state

issues.title: Make DAG readiness and validation share a real seam
Create a graph projection from materialized task state
issues.dod: A graph projection module is built from materialized state and exposes ancestry, descendants, blockers, blocks, hierarchy, cycle detection, and depth through one interface.

acceptance.description: validation and readiness can consume the same graph projection

issues.title: Move validate, ready, claim, and context traversal onto the graph projection
issues.dod: DAG invariants and traversal logic are removed from consumer modules where practical; validate, ready, claim, and render-context use the graph projection for shared graph knowledge.

acceptance.description: consumer modules no longer duplicate cycle, ancestry, descendant, or blocker traversal rules

issues.title: Deepen the harness-hook command into a hook runner module
Extract hook runner semantics from the Cobra command
issues.dod: harness-hook command delegates stdin decoding, state loading, policy resolution, evaluation, structured result, and exit-code mapping to an internal hook runner module while preserving existing behaviour.
issues.scope: cmd/armature/harness_hook.go, cmd/armature/harness_hook_test.go, internal/harnesshook/evaluator.go, internal/harnesshook/runner.go (new), internal/harnesshook/runner_test.go (new), internal/harnesspolicy/resolver.go

acceptance.description: hook policy behaviour is testable through an internal runner interface without requiring Cobra

issues.title: Consolidate harness platform adapter selection
issues.dod: platform adapter selection has one registry used by hook runner and launcher code, with Codex, Claude, and Devin adapters preserved and covered by tests.
issues.scope: internal/harnesshook/launcher.go, internal/harnesshook/platform_codex.go, internal/harnesshook/platform_claude.go, internal/harnesshook/platform_devin.go, internal/harnesshook/platform_test.go, cmd/armature/harness_hook.go

acceptance.description: adding a harness platform requires one registry change
